description.value: Mon Petit Choux is a French-inspired artisan bakery and café on Nanaimo's historic Commercial Street, offering house-made breads, croissants, quiches, and a full petit déjeuner menu. The kitchen produces everything from tourtière and Provençal pissaladière to delicate olive oil breads scented with orange blossom water. Touring cyclists passing through Nanaimo on a weekend would find it a distinctive stop for a proper sit-down French breakfast or a packed sandwich made on house-baked baguette.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is a menu-only site with all posts dated September 8, 2020, confirming the business is a French-inspired bakery and café rather than a grocery store. The menu lists hot breakfast dishes (Croque Madame, bacon and eggs, French toast) and hot/warm lunch items, supporting a hot-food value. No cycling amenities (bike parking, water refill, racks, charging) are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags, so all remain null.
concerns: All website posts are dated September 8, 2020 — the site has not been updated in over five years, making it unclear whether the menu or operating status is current.
OSM opening_hours tag shows the business is closed Monday–Thursday (only open Fri, Sat, Sun), which is a significant limitation for weekday touring cyclists.
